notes.title: “Mortgage Me Daddy” – Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]\[City, Date] — [i]Mortgage Me Daddy[/i], the indie satirical clicker game about the struggles young people face when trying to get a mortgage, is now officially available on Steam for just €1.[/p][p]Created by an independent developer using Unity and developed in the province of Udine, Italy, [i]Mortgage Me Daddy[/i] offers a simple yet brutally honest experience: click “Request Mortgage” and get denied — every time, with sarcastic and sometimes painfully realistic responses such as:[/p][list][*][p]“Do you even have a job?”[/p][/*][*][p]“Come back in 40 years.”[/p][/*][*][p]“Try clicking 1,000 more times.”[/p][/*][*][p]“The market said no.”[/p][/*][/list][p]With over 50 unique refusal phrases, a minimalist interface, and a global click counter updated in real-time, the game provides a darkly humorous take on the housing crisis faced by many young adults today.[/p][p][b]Key features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Over 50 sarcastic mortgage refusal messages[/p][/*][*][p]Universal English humor[/p][/*][*][p]Real-time global click counter[/p][/*][*][p]Available now on Steam for just €1[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Mortgage Me Daddy[/i] is perfect for those who appreciate digital satire and want to reflect on a serious social issue with a touch of bitter humor.[/p][p][b]Play now:[/b]
🌐 Website: [/p][p][url="https://mortgagemedaddy.com"]https://mortgagemedaddy.com[/url][/p][p]
🎮 Steam: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3774510/Mortgage_Me_Daddy/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
